UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT
FOR THE EASTERN DISTRICT OF VIRGINIA
ALEXANDRIA DIVISION

MARVELLE J. BALLENTINE, Plaintiff, v. KATIE HALL, individually; NATIONAL CENTER FOR MISSING & EXPLOITED CHILDREN; META PLATFORMS, INC.; and JOHN/JANE DOES 1–6, Defendants. ____________________________________/ | Case No. 1:26-cv-02331

NOTICE OF WAIVER OF ORAL ARGUMENT AND REQUEST FOR PROMPT DETERMINATION ON THE PAPERS

Plaintiff Marvelle J. Ballentine waives oral argument on Plaintiff’s Motion Under Rule 26(d)(1) for Present Authorization to Serve Two Interrogatories on Meta Concerning Plaintiff’s Full Legal Name and Facebook Account, submitted on [date], and requests that the Court direct submission and determination of that Motion on the papers under Local Civil Rules 7(E) and 7(J) and Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 78(b). This Notice is filed with the Motion in accordance with the Clerk’s Office filing guidance for the Alexandria Division concerning a waiver of oral argument submitted with a motion.

Plaintiff requests prompt determination upon completion of the briefing provided by Local Civil Rule 7(F)(1), subject to the Court’s directions. The current consequences of the unresolved association described in the supporting Declaration, and the deferral history described in Parts V and VII of the Memorandum in Support, make the limited answers requested time-sensitive. This waiver does not shorten any response or reply period under Local Civil Rule 7(F)(1).

[State counsel’s actual position on submission on the papers from the telephone conference: that counsel agreed, that counsel did not agree, or that counsel stated no position. Claim neither consent nor opposition without it.] If counsel does not agree to submission on the papers, Plaintiff maintains this waiver and asks the Court to determine submission under Local Civil Rule 7(J). The Court retains authority to direct oral argument; Plaintiff does not request it.

This waiver applies only to argument on the Motion identified above. It does not withdraw the Motion or alter any hearing request, notice, or waiver concerning another pending matter.

Date: __________, 2026		                      Respectfully submitted,

Marvelle J. Ballentine
